text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Hishi Akebono tries to track down me down, Taiki Shuttle compliments her on how unique and singular her running style is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono nods with immediate understanding. She grabs me and takes me to the kitchen… and immediately starts making chanko!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There, she tells me that she wants keep racing as the big, powerful Hishi Akebono that her fans want to see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if her career is cut short, she wants to protect her flavor. The chanko she serves me is the same, delicious flavor as always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's something special about eating food that's so familiar. We decide to prepare for the Mile Ch. without changing her running style!
